description: The complete Poland income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Employment (umowa o pracę): employee ZUS with the 282,600 zł ceiling, 9% health, 250/300 zł costs, 50% author's costs with the 120,000 zł cap, PPK, employer cost; Civil-law contracts: umowa zlecenie (20% costs, ZUS, health) and umowa o dzieło (20% / 50% costs); Scale 12%/32% with the 30,000 zł tax-free amount; exempt pay under 26, on return, for 4+ children and working seniors (shared 85,528 zł limit); Business (B2B) under the scale, flat 19% (liniowy) and ryczałt, each with its health contribution rules and full/preferential/start ZUS — all three compared; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in PLN; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: A Polish personal income tax return (zeznanie PIT) for tax year 2026 (1 January – 31 December 2026), due 30 April 2027. Every amount is in złoty (PLN) for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

age.description: Age on 31 December 2026. Under 26: pay up to 85,528 zł is exempt (ulga dla młodych). Default 35

business.description: Sole proprietorship or B2B contract (jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza)

costs.description: Deductible business costs (koszty uzyskania przychodu); ignored under ryczałt, złoty for 2026

form.description: Form of taxation (forma opodatkowania): skala (scale 12%/32%), liniowy (flat 19%) or ryczalt (lump sum on revenue). All three are computed and compared. Default skala

ryczalt_rate.description: Ryczałt rate in %, one of 17, 15, 14, 12.5, 12, 10, 8.5, 5.5, 3, 2, by activity, e.g. 12 for IT services, 8.5 for most other services, 15 for professional/consulting services, 14 for health and engineering services, 3 for trade. Default 12

zus.description: Social insurance (ZUS): full (base 5,652 zł a month), preferential (first 2 years, base 1,441.80 zł), start_relief (ulga na start: 6 months none, then preferential) or none (e.g. already insured through employment at minimum wage or more). Default full

crypto_costs.description: Crypto purchase costs, incl. unused costs carried from earlier years, złoty for 2026

crypto_proceeds.description: Crypto-assets sold for money, goods or services, złoty for 2026

dividends.description: Dividends from Polish companies (tax withheld at source), złoty for 2026

foreign_dividends.description: Dividends and interest from abroad, gross, złoty for 2026

foreign_tax_withheld.description: Tax withheld abroad on them, złoty for 2026

interest.description: Interest from Polish banks and bonds (tax withheld at source), złoty for 2026

losses.description: Securities losses of 2021-2025 still to deduct (at most 5)

one_off.description: Deduct at once (up to 5 million zł) instead of at most 50% of the loss a year

securities_costs.description: Their purchase costs and fees, złoty for 2026

securities_proceeds.description: Sales of shares, bonds, ETFs, fund units and derivatives, złoty for 2026

children.description: Children you are bringing up (under 18, or up to 25 in school with low income) for child relief (ulga na dzieci)

copyright_work.description: Contract for a work transferring copyright (umowa o dzieło z prawami autorskimi): 50% costs, no ZUS, złoty for 2026

mandate.description: Mandate contract pay (umowa zlecenie): 20% costs, złoty for 2026

mandate_zus.description: ZUS and health are paid on the mandate. Default true; false for students under 26

specific_work.description: Contract for a work without copyright (umowa o dzieło): 20% costs, no ZUS, złoty for 2026

blood_litres.description: Blood donated without pay, litres (130 zł a litre, within the 6% limit)

donations.description: Donations to public-benefit organisations and churches (darowizny), at most 6% of income, złoty for 2026

ikze.description: IKZE contributions: at most 11,304 zł, or 16,956 zł with a business, złoty for 2026

internet.description: Home internet paid (ulga internetowa), at most 760 zł, złoty for 2026

rehabilitation.description: Rehabilitation expenses of a disabled person (ulga rehabilitacyjna), actual costs, złoty for 2026

rehabilitation_car.description: Own car used for a disabled person's needs, at most 2,280 zł, złoty for 2026

thermo_modernisation.description: Thermal modernisation of your own single-family house (ulga termomodernizacyjna), at most 53,000 zł in total, złoty for 2026

employment.description: Employment contract (umowa o pracę), from your PIT-11

accident_rate_pct.description: Employer accident insurance rate (składka wypadkowa), % (employer cost only). Default 1.67

commuter.description: You live in another town than your workplace: costs 300 zł a month instead of 250 zł

copyright_pay.description: Part of the gross pay for creative work with copyright transfer: 50% author's costs (autorskie koszty), at most 120,000 zł, złoty for 2026

gross.description: Gross pay (wynagrodzenie brutto) incl. bonuses and taxable benefits, złoty for 2026

ppk_employee_pct.description: Your PPK (employee capital plan) contribution, % of gross: 0 if not enrolled, basic 2, max 4

ppk_employer_pct.description: Employer PPK contribution, % of gross: basic 1.5, max 4 (taxable income for you)

eu_75_percent.description: Non-resident living in the EU/EEA or Switzerland with at least 75% of your income from Poland: allows joint filing and child relief

filing.description: How to file: separate (indywidualnie), joint with your spouse (wspólnie z małżonkiem) or single_parent. Every allowed way is computed and compared. Default separate

abolition_relief.description: Credit method: claim the abolition relief (ulga abolicyjna), at most 1,360 zł

income.description: Income from abroad after costs and foreign social contributions, in złoty (NBP rate of the day before), złoty for 2026

method.description: The tax treaty's method: exemption (wyłączenie z progresją, e.g. Netherlands employment) or credit (proporcjonalne odliczenie). Default exemption

tax_paid.description: Income tax paid abroad on it, in złoty, złoty for 2026

married.description: Married for the whole of 2026 with joint property (wspólność majątkowa)

balance_paid_on.description: Date you pay the balance, YYYY-MM-DD; after 30 April 2027 late-payment interest (odsetki za zwłokę) runs

business_advances.description: Advances paid on business income (incl. ryczałt), złoty for 2026

employer_advances.description: Advances withheld by your employer and contract payers (zaliczki, PIT-11), złoty for 2026

late_interest_rate_pct.description: Late-payment interest rate, % a year. Default 10.5 (rate since 5 March 2026)

other.description: Anything else already paid, złoty for 2026

rental_advances.description: Ryczałt paid on rent, złoty for 2026

reliefs.description: Other exempt-pay reliefs sharing the 85,528 zł limit with the under-26 relief

family_4_plus.description: Parent of 4 or more children (ulga dla rodzin 4+)

return_to_poland.description: Moved residence to Poland in 2023-2026 after at least 3 years abroad (ulga na powrót), up to 4 years

working_senior.description: Reached pension age (60 women, 65 men), still working, not drawing the pension (ulga dla pracujących seniorów)

rental.description: Private rental income (najem prywatny), your share of the rent: ryczałt 8.5% up to 100,000 zł, 12.5% above, złoty for 2026

residency.description: Tax residence (rezydencja podatkowa): resident (centre of life in Poland or over 183 days there: taxed on worldwide income) or non_resident (Polish income only). Default resident

residency_facts.description: Optional: work out residence from these facts instead of `residency`

centre_of_vital_interests.description: Your home, family or main economic ties are in Poland (ośrodek interesów życiowych)

single_parent.description: Unmarried, divorced, separated or widowed and raising a child alone (osoba samotnie wychowująca dziecko)

advances.description: PIT advances withheld from the spouse's pay, złoty for 2026

employment.description: Spouse's gross employment pay, złoty for 2026

other_income.description: Spouse's other income on the scale, after costs and own ZUS, złoty for 2026
